script.text: On the third night, you camp on a hill. Ellie's fever is going down. Your mom is finally asleep. And you look out over the dark valley.
That's when you see it. A light. Not a fire. A steady, white, electric light, on the far side of the valley.
You wake your mom. She sees it too. She doesn't say a word. She just grabs your hand.
It's impossible. Every wire on Earth is dead. Unless someone, somewhere, found a way around the rule.
Then the light blinks. Three times. Like a signal. Like it knows you're watching.
So what would you do? Stay in the city, or walk away from everything? Tell me in the comments.

And is any of this real? The science is. Pumps push your water. A fridge keeps food safe for four hours. Fertilizer feeds half the world. And whoever is behind that light? You'll find out in part two.

and whoever is behind that light? Slow push back toward it
